# Inscription Reading

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:InscriptionReading`](gmeow-InscriptionReading.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/InscriptionReading>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/archaeological-evidence`](../../slices/archaeological-evidence.md)

A scholarly reading of an inscription — the [`Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md) that produces a [`LexicalForm`](gmeow-LexicalForm.md) from a sign-bearing feature. The reading is a standpoint-scoped claim, not ground truth: two scholars may read the same marks differently, and both readings coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). Follows the universal [`Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md) + Relator pattern.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:InscriptionReading`](gmeow-InscriptionReading.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
